Idle möbius is much lighter: the in-app browser now starts the first time you open a browser or desktop view, so until then the app runs as one process with no browser helpers, timers or disk writes. In a side-by-side idle measurement that cut memory from 174 MB to 73 MB and threads from 82 to 8. Opening möbius a second time brings back the running window, including from the menu bar.

The model popover reads like iOS, with the label on the left and the model and effort on the right. Usage's Daily, Weekly and Cumulative control spans the activity card, the Appearance row is "Font", and every content separator uses the same middle dot.

Bundles gateway 0.16.33 (protocol 93), unchanged from 0.10.11. Build 28.
